mode: isolated real Detail renderer with synthetic bridge; external network blocked; no real mutation or phone credential access

acceptance.implementation: native API binding and readback guarded
acceptance.authenticatedLive: not performed; requires desktop login and real server permission/quota

checks: only original author with valid explicit quota sees hide; missing fields, other author and invalid context do not invent permission
hide preparation rereads exact comment and cancel closes clearly without a mutation
fresh server quota supersedes a stale enabled row and cannot be confirmed after exhaustion
confirmed hide preserves paging, sorting, scroll and expanded replies and updates the record from readback
resume uses the explicit hidden-state action and preserves the visible comment
a newer page-one server refresh supersedes prior local confirmations without changing sort selection
unconfirmed writes keep comments and only reread the original record without automatic mutation replay
manual official verification replays the same confirmed action and leaves no unrelated write capability
changing account while a write resolves drops its result and never applies old-author state to the new account
an old verification finishing after an account change cannot replay or show a successful hide
guest reading never offers author hiding or authenticated visibility calls
